items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Ezbon' appears only in a note as '[Ezbon] Moseby', likely a correction or clarification of the interviewer's mention of 'Edgar Mobley'. The interviewee does not mention Ezbon/Moseby directly, nor does he confirm a personal relationship with this specific individual in the provided text.

ctx.x: Yes, way back. And we used to -- people like D. W. Griffith, and all those big directors used to frequent the club all the time. And oh, it was a gorgeous life in those days. Beautiful.
Edgar Mobley (PHONETIC) told me that they had all the movie stars of Hollywood, William Randolph Hearst --
